column1: # Loads are uniform uplift loads in pounds per lineal foot (plf) per purlin line
column2: applied by evacuating a vacuum chamber above the roof system; the reported loads are applied (vacuum) loads only and do not include dead load.

column1: # Tributary width: base tests and three-purlin-line confirming tests used purlins 5 ft on center with 1 ft (base) or 2 ft 2-3/8 in. (confirming) panel overhangs; four-purlin-line (opposed) confirming tests used purlins 3 ft 7 in. on center with 1 ft 9-7/8 in. overhangs. Panel/deck stiffness analysis (Figure 3.2) showed that in four purlin line tests the external (eave and ridge) purlins receive about 12% more load than the interior purlins.

column2: cut from a failed purlin); the appendix summary sheets list measured thicknesses that may differ by 0.001 in.

column3: 7-8) states that the Virginia Tech uplift failure loads in MBMA_9001 and MBMA_9102 were reported with an error in the tributary area
column4: and its Table 1 prints corrected loads. failure_load_as_printed keeps this report's measured value; failure_load_corrected_9702_plf holds the MBMA_9702 Table 1 value where the set match is clear (same designation; confirming loads agree within about 2%).
